svg.title: Cycles, minute by minute
svg.desc: The measured hour of the cycles scenario, the sudden jump and the recovery: offered load, share of requests answered within 500 ms and ready pods for each setup.
svg.text: Every 10 minutes: 3 minutes quiet, a 2-minute climb to about 75 requests per second, 3 minutes at the top and a
2-minute descent. Requests get heavier for 3 minutes in the middle of each cycle. Then the same sudden jump.
Requests missed so far (not answered within 500 ms)
